summary: This ultra-short clip presents Jeanne Bliss describing clarity of purpose as a core principle for customer experience. It defines clarity of purpose as uniting the organization and shifting focus from merely executing tasks to delivering an experience that customers would want to repeat. The message emphasizes organizational alignment and a customer-centric outcome over isolated workflow steps, encapsulated in a concise two-sentence moment.
title: Clarity of Purpose: Uniting Organizations to Deliver Repeatable Customer Experiences
